text:
Elena Park: FYI NimbleWorks (SI) hit a hard stop during Cardinal Health private deploy. Node boots but the Redwood agent craps out on module load + image attestation. Need fast arch sync.
Samir Gupta: paste logs?
Elena Park: from node-2: `modprobe: ERROR: could not insert 'nv_accel': Invalid module format` and `redwood-agent: attestation failed: unknown signer (key id: 0x9f4b)`
Maya Torres: two tracks: kernel module ABI vs signer trust. which is blocking customer acceptance?
Elena Park: both. Customer compliance team won't allow images not passing attestation. NimbleWorks CI signs with their org key which we don't have.
eng-security: we require partner keys uploaded to partner onboarding API. Quick question: can NimbleWorks provide a cert chain or do we pull their public key?
partner-ops: they offered public key upload w/ fingerprint `9F:4B:AA:77:12:...`. Prefer not to have them re-sign thousands of builds.
Samir Gupta: eng-runtime 11: do we have a compatible `nv_accel` build that matches RHEL 8.5 kernels?
eng-runtime: we have `nv_accel` v2.2 built for RHEL8.5 (kernel 4.18.0-240). Need their exact `uname -r`. If mismatch we can produce a compat build but takes ~6 hours.
Elena Park: customer nodes say `uname -r` -> `4.18.0-305.el8.x86_64`.
Maya Torres: so v2.2 might not load. Options: (A) eng-runtime build a kmod for 4.18.0-305 and bake into private image signed by Redwood (fast hotfix), (B) onboard NimbleWorks key to attestation pipeline (longer but proper), (C) route traffic to Dedicated as fallback.
infra-bot: ticket PARTNER-5012 created: "NimbleWorks key onboarding + nv_accel kmod compat" assigned eng-runtime, eng-security, partner-ops. Triage ETA 3h.
partner-ops: NimbleWorks asked for an architecture review before we touch their CI. Can we schedule a 30m sync?
Samir Gupta: I can do 18:00 UTC today.
eng-security: we'll need their public-key PEM and CA chain (if applicable). Also want to know whether their CI rotates keys frequently.
Elena Park: they rotate weekly but will freeze a single signing key if we require.
Maya Torres: action items: 1) Elena to collect `uname -r`, k8s version, node labels 1h. 2) eng-runtime to prototype kmod build + private image with kmod signed by Redwood EOD. 3) eng-security to draft partner-key onboarding checklist and quick rollback blocklist 4h. 4) partner-ops to run smoke with NimbleWorks and Cardinal Health once image ready  after image.
Samir Gupta: debugging command for capture: `uname -r; lsmod | grep nv_accel || true; dmesg | tail -n 50` and `cat /var/log/redwood/agent.log | tail -n 100`
eng-runtime: will attempt build now. If kernel headers mismatch we may need their kernel-devel rpm. Can partner provide?
partner-ops: NimbleWorks can publish kernel-devel package to a secure bucket for us to fetch.
Maya Torres: contingency: if we can't get hotfix in <= 48h, prepare a Dedicated routing plan and a customer-facing note acknowledging the window.
Elena Park: NimbleWorks asking if we can fast-track their key onboarding instead of image swap. Which path is lower risk?
eng-security: onboarding a partner key into attestation is higher audit/work but once done it's the right long-term fix. Short term Redwood-signed kmod image is lower blast radius and we control signing.
Samir Gupta: agree. propose hybrid: 1) push Redwood-signed image with kmod for immediate unblock, 2) run key onboarding in parallel.
partner-ops: shared invite for arch sync: 2025-04-07 18:00 UTC.
Elena Park: thanks all. I'll upload node metadata and the key fingerprint to PARTNER-5012 tonight.
eng-runtime: posted image digest to ticket: `sha256:abcd1234...` (not for prod until eng-security sign-off).
eng-security: received. We'll run attestation simulation once key is onboarded.
Maya Torres: closing thread for now 1 will follow up in PARTNER-5012 and the calendar invite. Ping #release-war-room if hotfix slips. :thumbsup:
